title: Progress
description: Tank levels grow from your battles, challenges rotate weekly and the season track pays out casings and profile cosmetics. Only your own battles count.
frozen: Levels are visible to everyone, but XP, challenges and casings accrue only with Plus.

shells.title: Casings
shells.hint: Never sold or cashed out — spent only on profile cosmetics.

tanks.title: Tank levels
tanks.description: XP from your battles on a tank, from Mir Tankov and mod data — up to level 25.
tanks.empty: No levels yet — they appear after battles with an active Plus.

challenges.title: Weekly challenges
challenges.description: Three challenges for each of your most played tanks this week.
challenges.empty: Play this week — challenges appear for your most played tanks.
